📝 Walkthrough
This PR adds source-derived identity and observation support across RDF core and text indexing. It changes segmented storage to profile 4, persists source directories and multisets, makes text-index updates incremental, and narrows WASM testing to audited platform-specific cases. **Changes: Source identity and observation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Multiset and canonical source identity**
`crates/hash/...`, `crates/rdf-core/src/source.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/term*`|Adds `Multiset256`, canonical streaming encoders, source-row hashing, source summaries, and source-evidence interfaces.| |**Segmented source persistence**
`crates/rdf-core/src/ir/statistics*`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/segmented/...`|Stores source summaries, effective directories, and source unions in the version 4 segmented format.| |**Source-change observation**
`crates/rdf-core/src/ir/source_directory.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/segmented/query/changes*`|Adds directory comparison, source-version capture, and transition reporting across segmented snapshots.| **Incremental text indexing** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Persistent index storage**
`crates/text/src/index.rs`, `crates/text/src/index/token_streams.rs`, `crates/text/src/surface*`|Replaces several vector-backed structures with shared persistent tables and profile-parameterized surface indexes.| |**Source-validated deltas**
`crates/text/src/index/delta.rs`, `crates/text/src/index/source_digest.rs`, `crates/text/src/error.rs`|Maintains source digests and coverage incrementally, observes only affected source rows, validates deltas, and updates changed index structures without rebuilding the full index.| |**Workspace-aware access**
`crates/text/src/relation.rs`, `crates/text/src/score.rs`, `crates/text/src/dictionary.rs`|Uses admitted workspace-aware lookups and propagates lookup failures through text query paths.| **WASM and validation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Audited WASM execution**
`.github/workflows/*`, `Makefile`, `docs/WASM_TESTING.md`, `crates/geo-kernel/examples/qualify_determinism.rs`|Removes semantic-only WASM jobs and broad target runs. Retains exact scalar and SIMD cases for named platform obligations and frozen identities.| |**Tests and records**
`crates/rdf-core/tests/*`, `crates/text/tests/*`, `helpers-ledger.toml`, `docs/design/*`|Adds source-observation, incremental-delta, allocation, determinism, format-certification, and capacity-proof coverage. Updates design documentation and identity expectations.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~90 minutes **Severity of issue fixed:** Medium ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TextIndex participant DatasetView participant SegmentedStackQuery participant Multiset256 TextIndex->>DatasetView: request source version and changed rows DatasetView->>SegmentedStackQuery: observe_source_changes SegmentedStackQuery->>Multiset256: update source records and effective directory SegmentedStackQuery-->>DatasetView: previous/next source transitions DatasetView-->>TextIndex: source evidence and statement counts TextIndex->>Multiset256: validate and update source digest TextIndex-->>TextIndex: merge changed documents and refresh coverage ```
Merge Risk: 🔵 Low · up to b9608
The geographic WASM job could pass without running its frozen-digest replay test if that test were renamed or removed. This is a small, localized CI fix. The guideline document also needs a cleanup of its preamble and examples. Neither affects runtime behavior, so the change is mergeable once the CI env line is added.

Full details: Linked Issues check
**Explanation** Linked issue [`#683`] asks for a TextIndex delta update whose work follows the delta. Its requirements, and the code that meets each one at head b96089f: 1. Incremental source fingerprint. `crates/hash/src/multiset.rs` adds `Multiset256`, a sum of 32-byte digests modulo 2^256 with an exact population. `crates/text/src/index/source_digest.rs` adds `SourceDigest` with `insert`, `remove`, and `observe`. `TextIndex::with_delta` in `crates/text/src/index/delta.rs` computes the new fingerprint from the digest. The update does not read the full source. 2. Validation without rereading the source. `with_delta` calls `validate_delta(rows, additions, removals, self.source_digest, observed_source)` before it edits any index table. The observed source comes from `observe_source`, which uses `visit_source_changes` when a previous source version exists. Otherwise it uses per-predicate `source_summary` values from predicate statistics. Neither path enumerates the complete next source. 3. Incremental coverage. `with_delta` calls `SourceCoverage::with_delta` using the added, removed, and observed coverage. `TextDeltaError::CoverageMismatch` reports disagreement. 4. Changed documents only. `with_delta` builds a subject set from the additions and removals and calls `collect_subject_rows(next, ...)`. It keeps only rows whose (graph, subject, language) key changed, analyzes those rows, and merges them with `merge_changed`. The full `collect_rows` call applies only to the small `added` and `removed` deltas. 5. Oracle. Tests in `crates/text/tests/determinism.rs` describe a 150-step walk that compares delta-updated indexes with fresh builds, including statistics and fingerprints. `crates/text/tests/delta_resources.rs` checks fresh-build parity and bounded growth at 128, 4,096, and 16,384 documents. Both files are named in the PR summary; I did not read their bodies. Gaps in this evidence: - The reviewed code excerpt covers `with_delta` and `observe_source`. I did not read the bodies of `validate_delta` or `collect_subject_rows`. Their behavior rests on the names, the PR summary, and the described tests. - The PR reports that no runtime tests ran after the WASM cull. Pre-cull results are reported as passing. The Katamari timing from the issue was not reproduced. The coding requirements of [`#683`] are implemented in the code I inspected.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check
**Explanation** The PR title and description combine two separate workstreams. Only the first relates to [`#683`]. Demonstrated unrelated changes (WASM test audit and documentation): - `.github/workflows/datalog-contracts.yaml` (-28 lines): removes the `wasm` job. - `.github/workflows/entail-errors.yaml` (-55 lines): removes the WASM role-refusal job. - `.github/workflows/segmented-storage.yaml` (-40 lines): removes the `wasm` job. - `.github/workflows/geographic-errors.yaml` (+1/-1) and `.github/workflows/coordinate-inputs.yaml` (-3 lines): change WASM case selection. - `Makefile` (+10/-381): replaces the `wasm-test` selection with a reduced list. - `crates/geo-kernel/examples/qualify_determinism.rs`: adds exact-name WASM filtering and a filtered-count check. - `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/WASM_TESTING.md`, `docs/agents/RUST_GUIDELINES.md`: add WASM policy and copy engineering guidance. - `helpers-ledger.toml`: refreshes ledger records and adds `multiset-256` and `source-row-identity` jobs. The WASM cull changes test execution and CI policy. It does not implement any [`#683`] objective. The PR description states this cull as a separate request. Changes that go beyond the stated [`#683`] scope: - Segmented storage format v3 to v4 (`crates/rdf-core/src/ir/segmented/format.rs`, `build.rs`), with header and layout changes. - Segmented source-version capture and change observation (`segmented/query/changes.rs`, `changes/directory.rs`, `view.rs`, `session.rs`). `with_delta` can run without these changes. Its `visit_source_changes` call falls back to predicate summaries when the source does not provide visits. - The `SurfaceIndex` and `FlatPostings` rewrite (`crates/text/src/surface.rs`, `surface/postings.rs`, `surface/substring.rs`). This includes public signature changes such as `words()` and `spans()` returning iterators. [`#683`] does not request surface-index changes. - Removal of `ShaclDatasetView::annotations_of_with_graph` (`crates/shapes/src/data_view.rs`). Some of these changes may be needed for source evidence or for `retained.with_index_delta`. The PR does not show that dependency for each change. **Resolution** 1. Remove the WASM audit from this PR. This includes the workflow edits, the `Makefile` `wasm-test` changes, the `qualify_determinism.rs` changes, the WASM and agent documentation, the `docs/agents/` copy, and the ledger entries that serve only that work. Submit them in a separate PR with its own issue. 2. For each segmented storage change (format v4, source-version capture, change observation, directory modules) and for the `SurfaceIndex` and `FlatPostings` rewrite, either: a. Show that the change is required by `TextIndex::with_delta` or by a [`#683`] test, and cite the call site, or b. Move it to a separate PR with its own linked issue. 3. Keep only the minimal `predicate` statistics and `source_summary` changes that the fallback path of `observe_source` requires, unless they move to a separate PR. 4. Restate the PR description so that it covers only [`#683`] and the changes that remain.
Full details: Docstring Coverage
**Explanation** Docstring coverage is 35.77% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. Docstring coverage is scoped to functions touched by this diff. Analyzed 534 functions across 50 files. (16 skipped: 10 unsupported, 6 over the file limit.) **Resolution** Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
